about: The status world of @miragon/pulse-c7-core/testing (seedC7StatusWorld: a call chain whose call activity holds a copy of the called instance's root incident, a multi-instance body's root incident beside an instance whose three items wait at the same element, a suspended batch's incident outside any process) seeded into operaton/operaton:2.1.5 twice, at history level full and at none; each engine's answers to the reads of engine_status (and pulse status, both c7-core's readStatus), the web app's verdict feed and the chat overview's health feed at asOf, what each of them gives and what the server's three judge at the two thresholds on the world's edge (ENGINE_HEALTH_CRITICAL_INCIDENTS at the root incidents engine_status counts and at one more), recorded by pnpm record:status-world.

  <bpmn:process id="pulse-status-approval" name="Approve items" isExecutable="true" camunda:historyTimeToLive="1">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_Start" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Event_Start_Activity_ApproveEach" sourceRef="Event_Start" targetRef="Activity_ApproveEach" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Activity_ApproveEach" name="Approve each" camunda:asyncBefore="true">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
        <bpmn:loopCardinality>${copies}</bpmn:loopCardinality>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Activity_ApproveEach_Event_End" sourceRef="Activity_ApproveEach" targetRef="Event_End" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_End" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:camunda="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/bpmn" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn" id="Definitions_pulse-status-approval">
  <bpmn:process id="pulse-status-approval" name="Approve items" isExecutable="true" camunda:historyTimeToLive="1">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_Start" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Event_Start_Activity_ApproveEach" sourceRef="Event_Start" targetRef="Activity_ApproveEach" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Activity_ApproveEach" name="Approve each" camunda:asyncBefore="true">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
        <bpmn:loopCardinality>${copies}</bpmn:loopCardinality>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Activity_ApproveEach_Event_End" sourceRef="Activity_ApproveEach" targetRef="Event_End" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_End" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
